model: Same 32-element radius-10-m free CR ring; EA=GA=10000, EI=GJ=500; two opposite Z triangular point loads, knots 0/2.5/5 s; initial rest; zero damping; duration 150 s.
scope: Same spatially discrete production model, candidate integrators and a self-converged cross-checked numerical time reference. Not an author-provided exact trajectory or independent verification of the CR spatial model.

candidate_settings.reference_velocity_atol: Reference factory binds actual velocity atol to displacement atol; record effective values and do not call equal requested tolerance equal accuracy.

inner_sensitivity.qualification: Compare entire histories to isolate iteration sensitivity; RK4 has no Newton iteration.

reference.crosscheck_algorithm: fixed RK4 with the actual CR auxiliary-history integration
reference.normalization: Uref=max over all 32 nodes and reference times of norm(position(t)-position(0)); floor 1e-6 m. Also report absolute vector error and component maxima.
reference.conditional_refinement_rule: If qualification fails, extend both reference sequences with the next halved step without changing thresholds. If still unqualified, retain failure and do not assign absolute accuracy pass to candidates.

comparison.times: Union of reference and candidate accepted times over 0..150 s; no phase alignment; cubic Hermite of positions and translational velocities. Check reference linear-versus-Hermite interpolation sensitivity at candidate times.
comparison.maximum_error: max over time and all nodes of norm(candidate_position-reference_position), normalized by Uref
comparison.rms_error: Time-weighted RMS of three-vector errors over all nodes, normalized by Uref
comparison.gate_policy: Each level receives its own accuracy result. Failure to meet threshold or decrease errors remains a failure; no tuning after inspecting results. Inner and outer failures reported separately.

execution.timing_qualification: Includes full output callbacks; timeout is incomplete evidence, not a numerical pass or an equal-accuracy speed ranking.
